[LSER.6.2] Here `t.mean` resolves to the `mean sliding 10_min`
observation declared on the slot. Same for `t.stdev`,
`t.variance`, `t.direction`, and other aggregations declared on
the slot. The cursor [LSER.6.10] is the binding alone (`t`);
it resolves to `state` because it is the only series-carrying
slot on this schema.
